content.text: Iaku bhekulaguaka lagu to kaasina molagina tee kaʼadili,
to Ingkoo, e KAWASANA OPU, iaku bhekulaguaka lagu kapujia.
Iaku bhekupengkaadhariaka carana mamudhaakana kudhadhi inda tee kasalahaku.
Naepia bhekupotibhaaka dhala sumai?
Iaku bhekudhadhi tee kakatena totona incaku i nuncana bhanuaku.
Iaku inda bhekudhikaia i aroaku
giu inda mokoampadhea.
Iaku kubancia o pewau motagalina Aulataʼala;
giu incia sumai amaridho tee iaku.
Iaku bhekupekaridho karoku tee fikiri inda mototo,
tee kumendeu kumatau tee saangu giu uka momadhaki.
Incemapo uka mofitanaana sarimbanuana i talikuna
bhekupabinasea.
Iaku inda bhekusabara
to mia mosombo tee momalangana incana.
Iaku kumaasiaka manga mia motaʼatina tee Aulataʼala,
mamudhaakana manga incia amembali amboore tee iaku.
Mia modhadhina i dhala inda mosala,
inciamo bhemolaianiaku.
Pande gau-gau
inda bheamboore i bhanuaku;
mia mobhoasakana kagau-gau
inda bheasadhaadhaa i aroaku.
Saesaeo bhekupabinasea
bhari-bharia mia madhaki i lipu sii,
mamudhaakana kupomofu bhari-bharia mia mopewauna kadhaki
minaaka i kotana KAWASANA OPU.
